t: You are on Lansdowne Road, a street in Holland Park. It takes its name from Henry Petty-Fitzmaurice, the third Marquess of Lansdowne, a statesman who served as Home Secretary and Chancellor of the Exchequer, and three times as Lord President of the Council. He sat in every Whig or Liberal ministry from 1806 to 1863. Bryan Burton Buckley, the second Baron Wrenbury, a British lawyer and peer, died on this street in 1940.
